notes.title: Beta branch update to Unreal Engine 5.4, performance improvements.
notes.notes: Updated the beta branch to Unreal Engine 5.4 , in my tests it gives better fps.

notes.title: small patch EA v0.28.1
notes.notes:
Small update focus on the space battles:


Improved enemy accuracy
Added nuclear spaceship
More asteroids
Indicator when an ally dies
Damage indicator for big enemies
New super attack.Volley: an insane amount of energy plasmas released, you can use it as an area attack or locking on an enemy all of them will follow it

notes.title: EA 0.18 hotfix: control settings.
notes.notes:
Small patch to fix the control settings not applying:
 
Sensitivity for both mouse and gamepad
 Invert Y applies in both flying and walking mode.
 They can be applied during gameplay
gamepad

notes.title: EA v0.10.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
This update is mainly to fix the tutorial. It was not packaged correctly and it was not loading.
Other updates:

 Shield and laser now have continuous energy consumption.
 Improved soldier performance while shooting.

notes.title: EA v0.06.2 patch
notes.notes:
Remove reset default key bindings for now, they make the skills in the keyboard to not work properly. It will be properly fixed later.
 Fixed UI cost for skill progress
 Skill progress was not saved properly

notes.title: EA v0.04.1 Small patch
notes.notes:
Fixed canyon mesh for DX11
 Corrected AI duplication for vehicles, weird behaviour when moving.
 Vehicles will have priority on roads and soldier will try to go on the sides.
